name: alert
title: Alert
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Alert: a 3px case with a tone shadow that pops in. destructive: accent line, a "!" column at the start and a shake when it appears. Title in lettering.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/alert". It wraps your own components/ui/alert, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.tagline: A case that pops in; errors shake with a “!”.
meta.usage:
import { Alert, AlertDescription, AlertTitle } from "@/components/ui/manga/alert"

<Alert variant="destructive">
  <AlertTitle>Upload failed</AlertTitle>
  <AlertDescription>Page 15 is too large.</AlertDescription>
</Alert>

props.name: variant
props.description: Destructive adds the accent and the “!” mark.
